Perhaps Marketing Agency started as a bold response to a tired, traditional agency model. Brands want a partner marketing agency that understands how partnerships move markets. They need expertise to cut through the noise and pair top advertisers with quality marketing partners who perform.

Perhaps Agency believes businesses of all sizes should have access to cost-efficient, effective partner marketing. That’s why we take a custom approach with each client, filling in the gaps where affiliate teams need additional support.

Over the past 20 years, our team has built and refined a strategic model that connects brands with top publishers, creators, and media. With both affiliate and influencer marketing agency experience and deep partnership roots, we saw the shift coming early. Discovery is becoming creator-driven, and brands need an experienced agency that helps them navigate this new reality.
Why Choose Perhaps Partner Marketing Agency?
With two decades of experience in affiliate marketing and influencer marketing, our team builds custom full-funnel partner strategies that align with your brand goals and deliver measurable results.
We maintain long-standing relationships with top-performing affiliates, influencers, and media, matching your brand with publishers that drive lasting reach, revenue, and ROI.

Thanks to an exclusive, zero-cost promotion with our partner, we secure premium platform rates and pass on the savings to you, for better ROAS across your program. No setup charges, transaction fees, or long-term contracts.
Perhaps Agency is built by experienced strategists who understand the mechanics of advertiser growth.
Each advisor brings years of hands-on influencer and publisher recruitment and management experience,
their work shaping the results our clients rely on.

Jen is Managing Director of Perhaps, a full-funnel partner marketing agency helping brands grow smarter through affiliate, influencer, and media partnerships. She specializes in turning partner ecosystems into scalable growth engines, designing programs where brands only pay for real, measurable outcomes rather than guesswork. With over 15 years of experience leading revenue and partnership teams, Jen builds strategies that connect the right creators, publishers, and media partners to deliver predictable, performance-based growth. She is especially focused on helping brands move partner marketing out of the “nice-to-have” bucket and into the center of their go-to-market plan through custom frameworks, clear economics, and trusted relationships.

A seasoned leader in account management and affiliate marketing, Brittany is also highly experienced in managing paid media channels like paid search and shopping, display/retargeting, cart abandonment, and paid social. With a background in multiple industries, she has an extensive retail background and has worked numerous years on the brand side.

Jeannine Crooks is a 27-year veteran of the performance marketing industry, with experience as an affiliate, merchant, tech provider, network manager, and agency founder. She is on the Board of Directors of the Performance Marketing Association and is a frequent speaker on affiliate marketing at conferences across North America.

Samantha brings five years of agency experience specializing in affiliate and creator partnerships. She has supported leading lifestyle DTC brands including Nutribullet, PetSmart, HEYDUDE, and Allbirds, developing and scaling high-performing affiliate programs. Skilled across platforms such as Impact, ShareASale, CJ, and TikTok Shop, she drives growth through influencer relations and strategic ecommerce execution. Passionate about client relationships and brand development, Samantha is dedicated to delivering measurable results and long-term partner success.

With more than two decades of experience building strategic partnerships and driving revenue growth, Tie Davidson has joined Perhaps. Throughout his career, he has helped shape partnership and growth initiatives at TUNE, accelerated publisher, advertiser, and affiliate network relationships at Tapjoy, and founded Black Phoenix Interactive, LLC, a boutique consultancy focused on affiliate, performance, and partnership marketing. Known for connecting the right people, ideas, and opportunities, Tie brings a blend of industry expertise, entrepreneurial grit, and a knack for turning conversations into long-term business growth.
Partnerships are entering a new era, and brands that adapt early will win big. Perhaps Marketing Agency helps you get ahead of the curve with AI-enabled analytics, speed, and strategy.

Many advertisers are feeling the pressure from rising ad costs and declining efficacy. Perhaps Agency offers visibility and optimization, building conversion paths for every step of the partner marketing funnel.
Perhaps Agency gives advertisers something rare: Zero-cost promotions. Access to proven partners. Strategic guidance shaped by a team that has scaled thousands of programs across multiple categories.
As a top partner marketing agency, we help brands grow through vetted relationships, optimized incentives, and performance frameworks that reduce spend and increase ROI.
